evidenceStatus: Documentation reviewed; not an INTA runtime certification

evidenceStatus: Documentation reviewed; not an INTA runtime certification

evidenceStatus: Official documentation and launch route reviewed; not an INTA Windows runtime certification.

evidenceStatus: Stable official release and documentation reviewed; scanner hardware and OCR output have not been tested by INTA.

name: Advanced IP Scanner
summary: Windows LAN discovery with IP addresses, host names, MAC addresses and exportable results.

cautions: Scan the actual authorized local range. A vendor or hostname match alone does not identify a printer: confirm its panel/configuration page, MAC address or web interface. Network segmentation and blocked probes can hide devices. Review the publisher terms for your deployment; the linked Radmin product has separate licensing.

evidenceStatus: Official supported Windows route and portable capability reviewed; discovery behavior has not been measured on an INTA network.

cautions: Best-effort recovery requires a working recovery environment and supported network. Enterprise-managed devices have cloud remediation disabled by default. Current guidance supports wired or WPA/WPA2 password-based Wi-Fi; confirm the managed policy and supported build before relying on it.
evidenceStatus: Official requirements and scope reviewed; no INTA boot or restore test is claimed.

name: Windows point-in-time restore (preview)

pricing: Included with supported Windows; availability depends on release, edition and management policy
cautions: Preview: rollback includes local user files, apps, settings, passwords, certificates and keys; changes after the selected point can be lost. The documented local restore runs in the recovery environment and needs the BitLocker recovery key on encrypted volumes. Local snapshots depend on disk space and idle time; they are not an independent backup.
evidenceStatus: Official requirements and scope reviewed; no INTA boot or restore test is claimed.

name: SetupDiag
summary: Analyzes Windows Setup logs to explain a failed feature update or operating-system upgrade.
bestFor: Finding the failure rule and related log evidence before retrying an unsuccessful Windows upgrade.
cautions: This diagnoses upgrade logs; it does not repair the computer. Preserve the relevant setup logs before cleanup and match the reported failure to the actual upgrade attempt.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

bestFor: Checking an approved package in a clean desktop before changing a workstation.
pricing: Included with supported Windows Pro, Enterprise and Education licensing; unavailable on Home
cautions: Requires a supported edition and enabled virtualization. Networking and clipboard sharing are on by default; configure them and read-only mapped folders for the test. Closing the sandbox discards its contents, but writes to a writable host mapping persist.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: USB Device Tree Viewer
summary: Displays USB controllers, hubs, device descriptors, negotiated speeds and connection details in a tree.

pricing: Freeware; publisher explicitly permits use in commercial environments
cautions: Current builds require Windows 8 or later. A descriptor or connection-speed report is evidence about enumeration, not proof of a good cable, adequate power or successful application I/O. The publisher restricts modification and downloader-wrapper distribution.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: powercfg
summary: Built-in Windows power diagnostics for battery usage, supported sleep states, wake causes and application power requests.
bestFor: Collecting battery and sleep evidence before changing hardware or power policy.
cautions: Start with reporting and query options. Other switches change power plans, hibernation or wake policy; review those changes separately. SleepStudy depends on supported power-state hardware, and reports can contain private device or usage information.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: curl
summary: Command-line client for inspecting HTTP responses, TLS connections, redirects and many other transfer protocols.
bestFor: Separating DNS, TCP, TLS and HTTP failures when a web service or application endpoint is unreachable.
pricing: Free and open source; the curl license permits commercial projects
cautions: Use curl.exe explicitly in Windows PowerShell when its curl alias refers to a different command. Compare the installed version and TLS backend. Keep credentials and headers out of public logs; disabling certificate verification is not a repair.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: mtr
summary: Repeated traceroute and ping-style measurements show latency and response loss along a network path.
bestFor: Comparing a reproducible path problem from a Linux or macOS bench, or Windows through WSL.
pricing: Free and open source under GPL-2.0
cautions: Intermediate routers can suppress or rate-limit diagnostic replies without dropping forwarded traffic. Correlate destination behavior and the application test. Windows use requires WSL or a separately built compatibility environment; the source archive is not a Windows installer.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: Remmina

bestFor: Connecting a Linux technician workstation to an already configured remote desktop or server.
pricing: Free and open source under GPL-2.0-or-later
cautions: This is a client: the target protocol, network access and authorized account must already be available. Package plugins and keyring integration vary. Verify host identity and certificate warnings; stored profiles may contain sensitive connection details.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: Syncthing
summary: Peer-to-peer synchronization keeps selected folders in agreement across approved devices without a central file-storage service.
bestFor: Keeping a defined healthy-data folder synchronized between authorized machines during a controlled transition or ongoing collaboration.
pricing: Free and open source under MPL-2.0
cautions: Changes and deletions propagate. Sync and optional versioning do not replace an independent tested backup. Confirm device identities, folder paths and conflict/versioning policy; do not synchronize suspected compromise into a clean recovery copy.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: DiskSpd
summary: Configurable Windows storage workload generator measures latency and throughput under a documented I/O profile.
bestFor: Reproducing a storage-performance complaint on healthy media with a bounded test file and comparable before/after settings.
pricing: Free and open source under MIT license
cautions: Use an approved test file on healthy storage and a bounded duration. Write workloads, raw devices and long runs can damage data or disrupt services; do not benchmark a failing source. Version 2.3 changes defaults, so compare equivalent profiles and record the version.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: WinMerge
summary: Visual comparison and merging of text files and folders makes configuration or migration differences visible.
bestFor: Comparing a saved configuration with the changed version or checking a copied folder before accepting a repair or migration.
pricing: Free and open source under GPL-2.0-or-later
cautions: Start in comparison mode and preserve originals before merging. Filters, ignored lines and timestamp-only comparisons can hide meaningful differences. A folder comparison is not an application-level restore test.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: SumatraPDF
summary: Lightweight Windows document reader with a portable build and standard PDF printing.
bestFor: Testing the same known-good PDF through an independent renderer to separate an application-specific print fault from the queue or printer.
pricing: Free and open source under GPL-3.0
cautions: Use a small known-good document and the intended queue, paper size and scaling. The stable route is 3.6.1; rolling documentation also describes 3.7 preview features, which must not be assumed available in the stable build. Check physical output after submission.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: netboot.xyz
summary: Network-boot menu loads installation and recovery environments through iPXE and supported boot media.

pricing: Free and open source; project code uses Apache-2.0, and boot components and selected operating systems retain their own licenses
cautions: The small boot image fetches additional content and is not a complete offline rescue system. Confirm network, architecture, firmware and Secure Boot requirements for the selected loader. Each installer can overwrite storage; preserve data and verify the selected target.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: promptfoo

pricing: Free and open source under MIT license; configured model/API providers can charge separately
cautions: The current CLI requires Node.js 22.22.0 or newer. Local execution still sends data to configured model providers, and optional hosted features have separate handling. Use sanitized examples and explicit assertions; a passing small test set does not establish general diagnostic accuracy.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

name: Windows LAPS

cautions: Deployment changes password management and needs the organization’s directory policy and delegated roles. Confirm the intended account, backup destination and authorized retrieval before relying on it. Supported builds vary; current Windows LAPS and legacy Microsoft LAPS are distinct.
provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.

cautions: Install with an approved configuration and retention plan; installation is a system change. It records events but does not analyze or remove malware, and cannot recreate earlier activity. provenance: Current primary documentation and publisher acquisition sources
evidenceStatus: Primary documentation reviewed; published file routes were checked with bounded response samples where supplied. No INTA installation, hardware, recovery or efficacy test is claimed.
